description: This file contains SDK functions for managing vector store files in the LiteLLM project, including create, list, retrieve, update, delete operations, both synchronous and asynchronous versions, with extensive use of external modules and internal utility functions.

classes.name: BaseLLMHTTPHandler
classes.description: Handler for HTTP requests related to vector store files.

classes.name: LiteLLMLoggingObj
classes.description: Logging utility class for LiteLLM SDK.

methods.name: _ensure_provider
methods.description: Ensures a provider string, defaults to 'openai' if None.

methods.name: _prepare_registry_credentials
methods.description: Prepares registry credentials for a given vector store ID.

methods.name: acreate
methods.description: Asynchronous function to create a vector store file.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a vector store file, supports both sync and async calls.

methods.name: alist
methods.description: Asynchronous function to list vector store files.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists vector store files, supports both sync and async calls.

methods.name: aretrieve
methods.description: Asynchronous function to retrieve a vector store file.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a vector store file, supports both sync and async calls.

methods.name: aretrieve_content
methods.description: Asynchronous function to retrieve content of a vector store file.

methods.name: retrieve_content
methods.description: Retrieves content of a vector store file, supports both sync and async calls.

methods.name: aupdate
methods.description: Asynchronous function to update a vector store file.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a vector store file, supports both sync and async calls.

methods.name: adelete
methods.description: Asynchronous function to delete a vector store file.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a vector store file, supports both sync and async calls.
